requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity and scan workflow features to enhance business efficiency and manageability for SMB customers. Includes Perfect Print and Perfect Scan solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB customer need for ROI and efficiency; differentiates HP from competitors via AI-driven features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and device management platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print/Scan) are available and functional in the product; positive feedback from pilot SMB customers; workflow automation reduces manual steps by at least 30%.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO with Minimal Intervention
requirements.Description: Design the printer to achieve HP’s lowest business total cost of ownership (TCO) with minimal user intervention, including cost-effective supplies and reduced maintenance requirements.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize cost efficiency and low maintenance; competitive differentiator against other SMB printers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires use of keyed bottles, customer replaceable parts, and efficient ink tank system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is demonstrably lower than previous HP models and key competitors; user maintenance tasks are reduced by at least 20%.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs, enabling easy device management, monitoring, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Target customers lack dedicated IT; need simple, centralized management for multiple printers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with printer firmware and AI solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports management of at least 6-15 printers per SMB; usability testing shows >85% satisfaction among non-IT users.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that customers can easily swap out without service center intervention, especially after warranty expiration.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs; aligns with the need for minimal intervention and ease of use.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new hardware design; must be compatible with existing service models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by users in <5 minutes with basic instructions; 90% success rate in user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent refilling errors and ensure correct ink usage, enhancing reliability and reducing user mistakes.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents misfeeds and ink contamination; important for SMBs with non-technical staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires redesign of ink tank and bottle interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 100% correct ink insertion in user testing; no cross-color contamination reported in validation trials.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure product supports PaaS models, enabling subscription-based printing, remote monitoring, and automated supply replenishment.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage; meets emerging SMB needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP’s PaaS backend and SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is compatible with HP PaaS offerings; successful pilot with at least one SMB customer.

requirements.Title: High Print Speed for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Deliver improved print speeds of 25/20 ppm for PDL SKUs, with support for PDL/PS and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses performance expectations for higher-end SMBs and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware enhancements; must meet Blue Angel standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in standard tests; passes Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Utilize at least 60% recycled content plastic in printer construction, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Meets growing demand for sustainability in SMB market; key differentiator for HP.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing of high-RCP materials and compliance with sustainability standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 60% of printer plastic by weight is RCP; compliance verified by third-party audit.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Parts & Serviceability
requirements.Description: Design major components (PHA) to be customer replaceable, and ensure MINK parts are serviceable at the service center, especially after warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime for SMBs; improves user experience post-warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular hardware design and clear service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: >80% of common failures resolved by customer replaceable parts; service center can replace MINK parts within 1 hour.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides confidence to SMB buyers; aligns with typical SMB usage patterns.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability testing and warranty program setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms clearly communicated; printer passes 80k page reliability test with <2% failure rate.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry to capture device usage, health, and predictive maintenance data, supporting remote diagnostics and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, reduces downtime, and supports PaaS business model.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and cloud integration; must comply with privacy and security policies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is captured and accessible via SMB portal; complies with HP security standards.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing via HP App, supporting key SMB use cases for remote and on-the-go printing.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for flexibility and supports hybrid work trends in SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires HP App compatibility and mobile print workflow integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing works with >95% success rate across supported devices; positive feedback from SMB pilot users.
